segments.he: וְהַבָּאִין מוּתָּרִין. אָמַר רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן לָקִישׁ: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא שֶׁאֵין קְשׁוּרִין זֶה בָּזֶה, אֲבָל קְשׁוּרִין זֶה בָּזֶה — אֲסוּרִין, אֵימָא דַּעְתּוֹ לַחְזוֹר.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And» with regard to «those who are coming» from a festival of idolatry, it is «permitted» to engage with them in business. «Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish says:» The Sages «taught» this «only» with regard to a case «where» those returning «are not attached to one another,» i.e., they are not traveling in groups. «But» where «they are attached to one another» it is «prohibited» to engage in business with them, as «I say:» The gentile «intends to return» to the festival with his companions.
